item.description:
Location: Mesaieed, Qatar
Description:

A Container Terminal experienced HSE Officer is sought for a project in Mesaieed, Qatar. The role requires a degree/diploma in Occupational Health & Safety or Environmental Management, a NEBOSH IGC or equivalent qualification, and a minimum of 5 years’ experience in a Container Terminal, including 3 years in a Safety Officer/HSE capacity. Knowledge of SOLAS, MARPOL, IMDG Code, PTW systems, risk assessments, and incident investigation is essential. Experience with vessel operations, RTG movements, lifting activities, and hazardous cargo handling is also required.



Apply to this job
